adjudication.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/embed.js, the iframe URL is built via simple concatenation: `iframe.src = discourseUrl + "embed/best?embed_url=" + ...`. There is no insertion/normalization of a `/` between `discourseUrl` and `embed/best`, so if `discourseUrl` is provided without a trailing slash (e.g., `https://forum.example.com`), the resulting URL becomes `https://forum.example.comembed/best?...`, which is malformed and will break embedding. The diff does not show any guarantee that `discourseUrl` always ends with `/`.
